categories.label: Warehouses
categories.description: Storage and fulfilment facilities, grouped separately from their operators.

categories.label: Bridges
categories.description: Physical road, rail and other transport bridges.

categories.label: Oil wells
categories.description: Individual extraction wells. Oil fields should not be represented as individual wells.

categories.label: Data centers
categories.description: Facilities housing computing and network infrastructure.

categories.label: Military facilities
categories.description: Named physical military sites; no operational intelligence is collected.

categories.label: Defence production
categories.description: Named physical production sites with a sourced defence connection.

categories.label: Drone facilities
categories.description: Named physical drone production sites; category alone does not imply defence.

categories.label: Robotics facilities
categories.description: Named physical robotics sites; category alone does not imply defence.

categories.label: Industrial production
categories.description: Named civilian or dual-use production sites, including materials plants, absent a sourced defence link.
